parent_objective: audit reset-only bounded panel feasibility before measured execution design
blocked_by: M1773 must be audited before measured execution design or repair
supersedes: direct bounded-panel measured execution without reset-result audit

public_gates: M1774 must use only M1773 reset artifacts and M1771 panel artifacts
M1774 must decide whether to admit measured execution design, sampling repair, label/role audit, or stop
M1774 must not run reset, rollout, train, replay, PPO, promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, or rank controller families
M1774 must preserve that M1773 is reset-only feasibility evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits reset-only bounded panel feasibility before any measured rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1773 did not cover all 288 cells
stop if reset failures or metadata gaps require repair
stop if any policy action or measured rollout was executed
fallback_plan: route to measured execution design if M1773 is coherent
route to sampling repair design if reset failures occurred
route to panel metadata repair if joins or labels are incoherent

admission_evidence: M1773 reports 288 reset successes, zero sampling failures, preserved role metadata, and zero guardrail violations
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1774 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured execution design or repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; M1774 audits task-quality reset feasibility and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit finds reset evidence insufficient, classify as scenario_sampling_failure, panel-design, or metric-contract issue, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1773 reset-only result can be audited as coherent enough to admit bounded-panel measured execution design.
success_criteria: M1774 uses only M1773 reset artifacts
M1774 makes the next route explicit
M1774 preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: audit ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1773 reset-only bounded panel artifacts without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1774 passes if it audits M1773 and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
